_note: Story 3 Hell-Dungeon on the hell runtime (src/hell/hell_game.gd, theme_path in src/hell/hell_dungeon.tscn). The hell look stays THEME_DEFAULT; this file only adds the hero systems the other worlds have. hero_from / hero_keys: these keys are taken from that theme file first, so classes, leveling, skills, relics, cards, sounds and music are shared with the Frostgruft and tuned in one place; keys written here override them. extra_sprites: textures the hero systems draw (relics, rock throws, the golem) loaded from dir when the world's own sprites lack them. No mobs key: the hell keeps its own monsters (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd).
